2117234380234174593.en_summary: $AAOI biggest asset is its U.S. manufacturing footprint and $MRVL ~$115B acquisition of $LITE just highlighted why. When one of largest independent laser makers is sold out through 2029 and being absorbed into a chip company then the independent U.S. optical manufacturing capacity becomes super valuable. The biggest catch is that AAOI’s 1.6T ramp is already delayed by DSP shortages and Marvell (major supplier of those chips) is now buying a competing transceiver business.
2117234380234174593.zh_summary: $AAOI 最大的資產是其美國製造足跡，$MRVL 約 1150 億美元收購 $LITE 剛好凸顯了這一點。當最大的獨立激光製造商之一售罄至 2029 年並被芯片公司吸收時，獨立的美國光學製造產能變得超級有價值。最大的問題是 AAOI 的 1.6T 爬坡已因 DSP 短缺而延遲，而 Marvell（這些芯片的主要供應商）現在正在購買競爭對手的收發器業務。

ticker_notes.AAOI: 美國製造足跡因 MRVL 收購 LITE 而更具戰略價值，但 1.6T 受 DSP 短缺影響

2117234262051270846.en_summary: Charles Schwab now allows you to trade select ETFs and stocks i.e. $SPY $QQQ $AAPL $NVDA $TSLA $AMZN $MSFT $GOOGL $META and other notables options an extended 2 hours (7:30am est) before the market opens. So it has begun! Good or bad thing? I think it’s good. More flexibility and options is always a good thing.
2117234262051270846.zh_summary: Charles Schwab 現在允許交易精選 ETF 和股票，例如 $SPY $QQQ $AAPL $NVDA $TSLA $AMZN $MSFT $GOOGL $META 以及其他知名期權，在市場開盤前延長 2 小時（美東時間 7:30am）。已經開始了！是好事還是壞事？我認為是好事。更多靈活性和選擇總是好事。
